data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, a name for a warrior or hero. Derived from the Greek word ursos, meaning 'bear'. The name Barde symbolizes strength, courage, and fierce protection. The name Barde carries the meaning “Son of the bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barde usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
